"MAX-A-MILLION" is about halfway through its run, with about half of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

MAX-A-MILLION's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Today's free summary of "MAX-A-MILLION" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
